examPage.note: THE HEADLINE FINDING. The operator created this page, cleared it, and made it the CURRENT page before every one of the 8 runs. All 8 emitted scripts ignored it and created no page: `newPages` was [] on every run. The emitted script owns file layout — it resolves the target by ds_contracts/contractId across EVERY page (allSyncTargets/resolveComponentIdentity) and, when no target exists, creates its own page named after the component. There is no --page flag, no file-scoping and no documented way to confine a mint to one page, so a first-pass mint CANNOT be isolated in the only writable file. Every set in this exam resolved to the pre-existing Census / altitude node and took the AMEND path; not one took the CREATE path this metric is meant to measure.

transport.how: each emitted mint/<component>.figma.js was served over http://localhost:9232 (inside the Desktop Bridge plugin's networkAccess allowlist, 9223-9232), fetched INSIDE the plugin sandbox, sha256-verified against the hash the harness recorded for the same bytes, and only then evaluated. The bytes executed are provably the bytes the harness emitted.
transport.firstAttemptTransportFailure: the first fetch used http://127.0.0.1:8791 and the plugin refused it with `Error: Failed to fetch` — the Desktop Bridge manifest allows only http://localhost:9223-9232. The emitted script never ran and no canvas byte moved, so the mint attempt counter was not consumed; the server was rebound to localhost:9232 and each script still ran EXACTLY ONCE.
